source_policy: Visual geometry supplied by source GLB. Armor resistance, internal anatomy, crew layout and all gameplay tuning are authored estimates, not verified vehicle specifications.
contact_policy: Only exact triangles score contacts. Gaps and apertures remain empty. Surface thickness is a game resistance assignment, never a measured mesh wall or confirmed historical value.
wall_pairing_policy: Pairs must be established by an authoritative penetration owner before applying entry/exit resistance. No automatic full-thickness charge on both faces.
